title: Anthropic’s IPO week: from pricing to the close of the deal and a second day of trading
intro: Slide through Anthropic’s IPO week to see how many shares were sold, how much money came in, and where the share price ended on Friday.
note: Share counts and proceeds are from Anthropic’s 20 November release and are gross, before underwriting fees and other costs. Not all IPO money went to Anthropic: existing shareholders who sold kept their part. The Wednesday figures are CNBC’s; the Friday close and market value are Reuters’. Market value is a fully diluted estimate at Friday’s price. Two days of trading say little about the company’s long-term value.
